about: Each case passes if the explorer's result matches ANY entry in `expect`. An entry passes when the action matches, `match` (if given) matches, and every string in `has` appears in the text of at least one target (case-insensitive, spaces collapsed). Node IDs are not used: they change when the page or the tree builder changes.
